dashboard.label: Weather Overview
dashboard.description: 15-minute ZENTRA Cloud readings (measurement, value, datetime). Precipitation is rainfall during each interval — Rainfall Totals sums those samples by logger_day.

search.query: `zentra_weather_search` | stats count by device_sn | sort device_sn

`zentra_canonical(air_temperature)` device_sn="$device_sn$" | stats latest(value) as temp latest(units) as unit latest(datetime) as datetime | eval value = if(isnotnull(temp), temp." ".coalesce(unit,""), "n/a") | fields value
`zentra_canonical(relative_humidity)` device_sn="$device_sn$" | stats latest(value) as rh latest(units) as unit | eval value = if(isnotnull(rh), rh." ".coalesce(unit,""), "n/a") | fields value
`zentra_canonical(wind_speed)` device_sn="$device_sn$" | stats latest(value) as wind latest(units) as unit | eval value = if(isnotnull(wind), wind." ".coalesce(unit,""), "n/a") | fields value
`zentra_interval_precip` device_sn="$device_sn$" | stats sum(value) as precip latest(units) as unit | eval value = if(isnotnull(precip), round(precip, 3)." ".coalesce(unit,""), "n/a") | fields value
`zentra_canonical(air_temperature)` device_sn="$device_sn$" | timechart span=15m avg(value) as air_temperature by device_sn
`zentra_canonical(relative_humidity)` device_sn="$device_sn$" | timechart span=15m avg(value) as relative_humidity by device_sn

`zentra_weather_search` device_sn="$device_sn$" measurement_canonical IN (wind_speed, gust_speed) | eval series=if(measurement_canonical="gust_speed","gust_speed","wind_speed") | timechart span=15m avg(value) by series
`zentra_interval_precip` device_sn="$device_sn$" | timechart span=15m sum(value) as precipitation by device_sn

`zentra_weather_search` device_sn="$device_sn$" | stats latest(latitude) as latitude latest(longitude) as longitude latest(eval(if(measurement_canonical="air_temperature",value,null()))) as air_temperature by device_sn | geostats latfield=latitude longfield=longitude latest(air_temperature) as air_temperature by device_sn
`zentra_weather_search` device_sn="$device_sn$" | stats latest(datetime) as datetime latest(value) as value latest(units) as units by device_sn, measurement, measurement_canonical | sort measurement
